name: What does walk-in tub installation coordination include?

mainEntity.name: What does walk-in tub installation coordination include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Walk-in tub installation coordination involves managing the entire renovation process required to fit an accessible tub into your bathroom. Beyond placing the tub, installation requires coordinating licensed trade partners for heavy-duty plumbing and dedicated electrical circuits, alongside finish work like custom framing, drywall repair, and waterproofing. At HH Remodeling, owner Abraham Becerra directly oversees the project as your single point of contact. His team handles the surrounding carpentry, drywall, and custom tile work, while coordinating qualified trade specialists for the specialized rough-ins to ensure your bathroom is safe, functional, and properly finished.
acceptedAnswer.description: Walk-in tub installation coordination oversees plumbing, electrical, framing, tile, and drywall work to integrate an accessible tub safely into your bathroom.
